questions.stem: An element has the electronic configuration 2,8,7. What is its group number?
questions.explanation: The group number equals the number of electrons in the outer shell. This element has 7 electrons in its outer shell, so it is in Group 7. It also has 3 electron shells, placing it in Period 3. This element is chlorine.

questions.stem: What is the maximum number of electrons that can occupy the first electron shell?
questions.explanation: The first electron shell can hold a maximum of 2 electrons. The second and third shells can each hold up to 8 electrons (for the first 20 elements). This is why Period 1 only contains two elements: hydrogen (1) and helium (2).
